title: AAPS taking into account previous reading
body:
Version 3.0.0.1, BG source xdrip:
If aaps looses bg readings (I get away from phone, phone restarts), and then gets updated reading + missed readings restored by transmitter, for some reason it takes into account the previous reading (the one before te most updated), until it gets the next one:
![Screenshot_20220403-181556_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/93551840/161551826-70c2d043-a9bb-4187-920b-79c85a9ee97f.jpg)
